📖 How to use

  1. Pick Rock, Paper or Scissors (or press R / P / S).
  2. The computer picks at the same time.
  3. Round winner and running score update live.
  4. First to 3 round wins takes the match — then play again.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Does the computer cheat?

The computer picks uniformly at random each round. There's no pattern to learn — it's honest luck.

How does scoring work?

It's best-of-5: the first player to win 3 rounds wins the match. Drawn rounds don't count for either side.

Is there a keyboard shortcut?

Press R, P or S on your keyboard, or just tap the big buttons.
